v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Christus resúrgens ex mórtuis iam non móritur, mors illi ultra non dominábitur. Quod enim mórtuus est peccáto, mórtuus est semel: quod autem vivit, vivit Deo.
text.en: Knowing that Christ rising again from the dead, dieth now no more, death shall no more have dominion over him. For in that he died to sin, he died once; but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

r.en: Let heaven and earth rejoice, alleluia.

text.la: Cognovérunt * Dóminum Iesum, allelúia, in fractióne panis, allelúia.
text.en: They knew the Lord Jesus * Alin the breaking of bread Alleluia Alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui errántibus, ut in viam possint redíre iustítiæ, veritátis tuæ lumen osténdis: da cunctis, qui christiána professióne censéntur, et illa respúere, quæ huic inimíca sunt nómini; et ea, quæ sunt apta, sectári.
text.en: Almighty God, Who showest to them that be in error the light of thy truth, to the intent that they may return into the way of righteousness grant unto all them that are admitted into the fellowship of Christ's Religion, that they may eschew those things that are contrary to their profession, and follow all such things as are agreeable to the same.

text.la: Fíliæ Ierúsalem, veníte et vidéte Mártyres cum corónis, quibus coronávit eos Dóminus in die solemnitátis et lætítiæ, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Daughters of Jerusalem, come and see the crowned martyrs, the Lord crowned them in his solemnity and delight, alleluia, alleluia.

v.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord, alleluia.

r.en: Is the death of his saints, alleluia.

text.la: Deus, qui nos beáti Geórgii Mártyris tui méritis et intercessióne lætíficas: concéde propítius; ut, qui tua per eum benefícia póscimus, dono tuæ grátiæ consequámur.
text.en: O God, Who dost gladden us through the worthy deeds and prayers of thy blessed martyr George, mercifully grant that all they which seek thy mercy through him may effectually obtain the gift of thy grace.

office.title: Feria Sexta infra Hebd III post Octavam Paschæ
